tokens.name: base-100
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, navbar, menus, inputs, the sidebar. daisyUI --color-base-100.

tokens.name: base-200
tokens.usage: Page background (the logo's paper white in light). Also list-row hover and table header fill. daisyUI --color-base-200.

tokens.name: base-300
tokens.usage: Hairlines only: card and section borders, dividers, list separators, inactive tracks. Never a ground for text. daisyUI --color-base-300.

tokens.name: base-content
tokens.usage: Body text and headings, on base-100 and base-200 (13:1 or better in both themes). The logo's ink. daisyUI --color-base-content.

tokens.name: base-content-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, timestamps, help text, placeholder text, on base-100 and base-200 (5.9:1 or better). Use instead of opacity-40/50/60 on text. Tailwind: text-base-content/70 is the closest daisy equivalent.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, textareas, checkboxes and the combobox, on base-100 (3:1 or better). In CSS: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 55%, transparent).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The single accent: primary button, links, focus ring, selected nav item, active tab. As text on base-100 and base-200 (6.4:1 or better). daisyUI --color-primary.

tokens.name: primary-content
tokens.usage: Label and icons on a primary fill (6.9:1 light, 9.4:1 dark). daisyUI --color-primary-content.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active sidebar item, current-version highlight. primary or base-content text on it.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Near-neutral secondary actions and filled neutral chips. daisyUI --color-secondary.

tokens.name: secondary-content
tokens.usage: Text on a secondary fill. daisyUI --color-secondary-content.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Sand from the mark. Decorative only: favourite star fill, landing illustration. Never text, never state. daisyUI --color-accent.

tokens.name: accent-content
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill. daisyUI --color-accent-content.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Tooltips, the dark chip for counts. daisyUI --color-neutral.

tokens.name: neutral-content
tokens.usage: Text on a neutral fill. daisyUI --color-neutral-content.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational alerts and the auditor role. As text on base-100, base-200 and info-soft. daisyUI --color-info.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of info alerts and badges, with info text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Published status, verified integrity, signed. As text on base-100, base-200 and success-soft. Always paired with a word or icon. daisyUI --color-success.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of success badges and alerts, with success text (5.6:1 light, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Release candidate, out-of-date signature, missing file. As text on base-100, base-200 and warning-soft. daisyUI --color-warning.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning badges, alerts and the out-of-date dashboard rows, with warning text.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Rejected status, hash mismatch, destructive actions, form errors. As text on base-100, base-200 and error-soft. daisyUI --color-error.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of error badges and alerts, with error text.

tokens.name: status-content
tokens.usage: Text on a solid info, success, warning or error fill (daisyUI --color-info-content etc.). Solid status fills are reserved for destructive buttons.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element. An alias of primary, 6.4:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: Logo blue. Cover, landing page and illustration only; in UI it appears as primary in the dark theme.

tokens.name: brand-sand
tokens.usage: Logo sand. Cover and illustration only (accent is the UI alias).

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Deep blue, the light theme's primary held constant. Cover and print (PDF exports) only.

families.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page: the h1 in the page header. Tailwind text-2xl font-semibold.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Card and section headings (h2). Tailwind text-lg font-semibold.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sign the latest published version of each SOP below.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and rendered SOP content (prose).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Default UI text: tables, lists, forms, menus. Tailwind text-sm.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, list-row titles, button labels, group headings inside cards. Sentence case, never uppercase-tracked.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, counts, help text, badges. The smallest size in the app: replaces text-[10px]. In base-content-muted.

styles.name: mono-id
styles.usage: IDs, version numbers, hashes. Not uppercased, no negative tracking. Truncate long hashes to 8 characters with the full value in a title attribute.

spacing.note: The Tailwind 4px scale. These are the steps the app uses; others are allowed but rare.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; icon-to-label gap in buttons and menus.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List-row vertical padding; gap between leading icon and text in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: List-row horizontal padding; card padding on phones; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding from sm up; gap between stacked cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter from lg up; top padding below the navbar.

tokens.name: radius-selector
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, toggles, badges. daisyUI --radius-selector.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, the combobox, dropdown items. daisyUI --radius-field.

tokens.name: radius-box
tokens.usage: Cards, alerts, menus, modals. daisyUI --radius-box.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars only.

shadow.note: The theme is flat (daisyUI --depth: 0). Separation comes from base-300 borders and the base-100 on base-200 step; the one shadow is for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, the combobox list, modals. Nothing that sits in the page flow.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Every border and divider. daisyUI --border.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs at the default size (btn, input). Touch-friendly.

tokens.name: field-height-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons inside list rows and toolbars (btn-sm).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page content column (Tailwind max-w-6xl).
